events.title: Unpacking That Trunk for Black History Season
events.description: Join writer, storyteller, educator and former Ealing councillor Grace Quansah (Akuba) for a special Black History Season celebration exploring family history, African heritage, faith and the remarkable stories preserved across generations.
events.excerpt: Grace Quansah (Akuba) talk: with storytelling, family photographs, historical discoveries and a reading from her book.

events.title: West London Junior Open Mic
events.description: A monthly open mic for children and young people aged 5-18! Whether you sing, play an instrument, do poetry, comedy or anything in between, go and share your talents!
events.excerpt: Young performers can share their talents and gain experience performing in front of an audience in a low pressure environment.

events.title: Little Kitchen
events.description: After a string of sold-out performances across Oxford and London, Little Kitchen, an innovative new-music collective is bringing its timeless and often heartwarming sound to Acton.
events.excerpt: an innovative new-music collective is bringing its timeless and often heartwarming sound to Acton.
